title: Footer shows all 15 navigation links
test_data: Expected links: Home, Products, Collections, Patterns, Projects, About, History, Sustainability, Design Partners, News, Request a Sample, Request a Quote, Careers, Resources, Contact
steps: Open /about/ on the dev environment and wait for the page to finish loading (about 3 seconds, so hero animation completes)
Read the labels of the footer navigation links
expected_result: Exactly the 15 links listed in Test Data are shown (the footer label is "Projects" while the header label is "Portfolio").

title: Footer nav link hrefs point to the correct pages
test_data: Home=/; Products=/products/; Collections=/collections/; Patterns=/patterns/; Projects=/projects/; About=/about/; History=/history/; Sustainability=/sustainability/; Design Partners=/design-partners/; News=/news/; Request a Sample=/sample-request/; Request a Quote=/quote-request/; Careers=/careers/; Resources=/resources/; Contact=/contact/
steps: Open /about/ on the dev environment and wait for the page to finish loading (about 3 seconds, so hero animation completes)
Read the href of each footer navigation link
expected_result: Each href equals the path in Test Data on the dev host.

title: Footer nav links resolve without errors
steps: Open /about/ on the dev environment and wait for the page to finish loading (about 3 seconds, so hero animation completes)
Request or open each footer navigation link
expected_result: Every link returns a success status and renders a page (no 404/500). Content of the target pages is not asserted.

title: Footer copyright line shows the current year range
test_data: Expected pattern: Skyline Design © 2020-<current year> | All Rights Reserved.
steps: Open /about/ on the dev environment and wait for the page to finish loading (about 3 seconds, so hero animation completes)
expected_result: The line matches "Skyline Design © 2020-<current year> | All Rights Reserved." where the end year equals the current year. The year is not hard-coded.
